mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees and clear at Badger Prairie County Park. We are currently under a waxing gibbous moon phase. Also, the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona announced that fall leaf collection starts October 5 with trucks making weekly rounds; remember to keep piles loose and off the street. Additionally, the Plan Commission meets on October 5 to review several development projects including new site plans and certified survey maps.

There is a busy schedule today including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, Wednesday pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at the Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch Hop Haus trivia tomorrow.
Regarding recent activity, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired; an officer was able to detain the suspect shortly after.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel today, so no flavor of the day is available.
